# Three.js dependency

Pinned version: **0.180.0** (r180), distributed under the MIT license in
`LICENSE-three.txt`. Both ES modules are served locally; the phone renderer
does not fetch code from a third-party CDN at runtime.

Unmodified distribution files:

- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.module.min.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/build/three.core.min.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/LICENSE`

The model, screen composition, and studio environment in `../phone3d.js` are
original procedural artwork. No commercial device model or Apple image is
included.
